text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Full of nutrients! Full of justice! 
Carotene charge, Carrotman!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trainer! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Over the break, I went to a 
show and shook Carrotman's hand!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my power of justice is 
tingling! All right, I'm gonna get even 
stronger in training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Biko Pegasus had a thoroughly 
fulfilling day off!
